title.zh: 查询域名推流数量限制和转码数量限制

descriptions.zh:
本接口支持的播流域名为主播流域名。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
This operation supports only main streaming domains.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 5 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions. For more information, see [QPS limit](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-domain-limit --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
